en-US.name: Norm
en-US.releaseNotes:
Version record: https://normlanguage.github.io/Norm/versions/0.27
The Windows and macOS binaries are not code-signed yet, so the operating system may display an origin warning. Verify downloads against SHA256SUMS and the attached build provenance.
What's Changed
- Bump @types/node from 26.6.4 to 26.6.5 in /cli/extensions/vscode by @dependabot[bot] in #112
- Bump vscode-languageclient from 10.1.2 to 11.0.0 in /cli/extensions/vscode by @dependabot[bot] in #113
- build(deps-dev): bump @types/vscode from 1.100.0 to 1.140.0 in /cli/extensions/vscode by @dependabot[bot] in #111
- Render application console log timestamps in ISO 8601 by @w0fv1 in #132
- Fix native application JSON recovery and module access by @w0fv1 in #136
- Allow applications to configure default logging destinations by @w0fv1 in #135
- Document Norm 0.27.30 by @w0fv1 in #137
